text: {"question":"How did the later study revise the estimated impact of spatial inhomogeneity on the Hubble constant compared to the earlier discussion of systematic uncertainties?","reference_answer":"The later work quantified that the geometric bias from spatial inhomogeneity on galactic scales is far too small—only a few percent—to explain the roughly 8 % discrepancy in H₀, whereas the earlier study highlighted a broader range of systematic effects without providing such a specific numerical bound."}
